app.name: Homebrew Template
app.short_description: Reusable template for Wii homebrew projects
app.long_description: This is a reusable template project for building homebrew applications for the Nintendo Wii using devkitPPC. It comes with a working build setup (Makefile) and an example that shows how C code can call routines written in PowerPC assembly. Use this template as a starting point for your own projects: copy the folder, rename the output target, edit source/main.c and source/math.asm, and run make. Building for your own project: set DEVKITPPC in your environment and run make to produce a .dol, then use main.py to package it into a .zip with boot.dol, meta.xml and icon.png.
